items.name: NestingContext
items.summary: Represents the syntactical nesting context of a given class or function.

methods.name: ancestor_function_path
methods.summary: Build a dotted path of only the enclosing *function* ancestors (skipping classes), e.g. `"f1.f2"` for a function nested inside `f1` which is nested inside `f2`. Returns `None` if there are no enclosing functions.

methods.name: class
methods.signature: fn class(identifier: ShortIdentifier, parent: NestingContext) -> Self

methods.name: fmt
methods.signature: fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>, ctx: &Module) -> fmt::Result

methods.name: function
methods.signature: fn function(identifier: ShortIdentifier, parent: NestingContext) -> Self

methods.name: owner_path
methods.summary: Build a fully-qualified owner string for type parameter disambiguation, e.g. `"module.Outer.Inner.name"`. Includes all ancestor classes and functions. Returns `None` for builtins (where disambiguation is unnecessary).
